As a mother and daughter team, Barbara Bear and Mama Bear bring this cherished narrative to life, infusing warmth and emotion into every word. Their heartfelt reading transforms the relationship between a child and their toys, illustrating how love can create something truly special. Perfect for bedtime, family gatherings, or quiet moments, this audiobook is a wonderful way to share a classic with the next generation. Join Barbara and Mama Bear as they honor the spirit of play, connection, and the sweetness of childhood memories. This recording is dedicated to Barbara Bear, who embodies the magic of being real.

title: Surprise House (Aunt Nan's Mysterious Gifts)
author: Abbie Farwell Brown
description:
When Dr. Owen Corliss inherits his eccentric Aunt Nan's peculiar house, he quickly discovers it’s more than just a family estate. With his wife and two children, Mary and John, he steps into a world filled with whimsical surprises, practical jokes, and riddles inspired by Shakespeare’s poetry. Each room holds secrets waiting to be uncovered, but the real mystery lies in Aunt Nan’s intentions. Why did she leave these curious clues? What truths about the family will they reveal? As the Corliss family navigates their new home, they find themselves on a treasure hunt that tests their bonds and challenges their perceptions of love, legacy, and laughter.

Join Owen, Mary, and John in "Surprise House" as they unravel the mysteries of the past while creating memories for the future. Each discovery leads them deeper into Aunt Nan’s enchanting world, where every corner might spark a new adventure or a heartfelt revelation. This audiobook invites listeners to embrace curiosity and the joy of family togetherness, all wrapped in a delightful blend of humor and intrigue. Perfect for listeners of all ages, prepare to be captivated by the unexpected twists that await in this charming tale of exploration, family, and the magic of a home filled with surprises.

title: AI and Autism
author: Autistic Culture Podcast Network
description:
AI and Autism explores what happens when artificial intelligence meets neurodivergent life.


Hosted by writer and AI strategist Bre Ransome, MA, this series brings together neurodivergent creators, thinkers and AI users from around the world to explore how artificial intelligence is becoming part of how we work, communicate, create and understand ourselves.


Across the series, Bre and her guests discuss using AI to navigate executive dysfunction, process thoughts and emotions, explore complex relationship dynamics and create new forms of cognitive support. Along the way, they consider not only what these technologies can make possible for neurodivergent people, but the questions, limitations and complications that come with them.


Whether you're an AI super-user, just beginning to experiment with it, or deeply sceptical about where this technology is taking us, AI and Autism is a space for neurodivergent people to work through the ways AI is changing our lives.


🎧 AI and Autism is available on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and all major platforms.

author: Leonard
description:

This podcast helps you understand what may actually be causing your symptoms, when physical therapy, injections, or time may be enough, and when spine surgery starts making sense.


Dr. Leonard Kibuule covers herniated discs, sciatica, spinal stenosis, cervical myelopathy, minimally invasive spine surgery, microdiscectomy, spinal fusion, artificial disc replacement, second opinions, and spine surgery recovery.


The goal is simple: help you understand your options and get back to walking, working, exercising, traveling, and living normally again.

  • Progressive Overload: How to strategically increase your reps and weight to guarantee consistent muscle growth.
  • Compound Movements: The essential big lifts you need to prioritize for maximum strength and efficiency.

title: Meteor
author: Md Shahidul Islam
description:
Meteor tells the true stories of cosmic impacts and the rocks that fall from space. Each episode, host Nirob takes one event — the meteor storm that set the sky on fire in 1833, the blast over the Siberian forest in 1908, the meteorite that crashed through a car in 1992, the comet that fell on Jupiter before the eyes of the world, the impact that ended the age of the dinosaurs — and rebuilds it: the moment of the fall, the witnesses who saw it, the search for the rock and the crater, the science that read the evidence, and what the event taught us about the danger from the sky.

From the meteorites worshipped in the ancient world to the craters of the deep past, from the fireballs that light up the modern sky to the planetary defence that is tracking the asteroids of the future, Meteor is the story of the solar system reaching down to touch the Earth. Meticulously researched, clear about the astronomy and the geology, and honest about the difference between the legend of a falling star and the science of a falling rock. Clean and suitable for all ages. A new fall every week

title: Life & Work in Saudi Arabia
author: Liam Parker
description:
Life and Work in Saudi Arabia is an informative podcast series created for expatriate workers, residents, employees, employers, and anyone navigating the practical side of working and living in the Kingdom. The series explores everyday topics connected with employment, residency, visas, travel permissions, workplace documentation, salary-related matters, and end-of-service planning.Each episode breaks down complicated administrative subjects into clear, practical conversations. Listeners can learn about the documents they may need, the importance of checking official records, how different government platforms serve different purposes, and why keeping track of important dates can make employment and travel planning easier.

One particularly useful topic is understanding how to confirm the status of a Saudi visa before making travel or employment plans. For listeners researching the muqeem visa validity check, the series can explain what information may appear in a Muqeem result, how visa status and expiry dates should be interpreted, and why users should enter sensitive identification details only through the appropriate official government service.The podcast does not replace official government services or professional immigration advice.

Instead, its objective is to help listeners understand the terminology, processes, and practical considerations involved in Saudi employment and residency administration so they can approach official services with greater confidence.Future episodes can cover exit and re-entry visas, final exit procedures, residency documentation, visa expiry dates, employment records, end-of-service benefits, workplace transitions, and the importance of maintaining accurate personal records.Series objectives:
  • Explain Saudi employment and residency processes in accessible language.
  • Help expatriate workers understand common visa and residency terminology.
  • Encourage listeners to verify important information through official government channels.
  • Discuss practical preparation for employment transitions and end-of-service situations.
  • Highlight the importance of checking dates, statuses, and official records before making travel or employment decisions.
  • Provide educational discussions that complement, rather than replace, official government guidance.

Hosted by comedians (and parents) Manon Mathews and Vincent Marcus, this show dives into the beautiful chaos of raising kids. From the impossible messes to the deafening noise, Manon and Vincent validate your stress while finding the humor in the madness. 
Tune in to feel seen, heard, and slightly less guilty about hiding in the pantry for five minutes of silence.

title: Antonio Borrello
author: Antonio Borrello
description:
I’m Dr Antonio Borrello, and I’m a psychologist and relationship coach. This channel is all about helping you build great relationships so you can grow happy with the people you love. So, if you’re interested in dating advice and relationship advice that is focused on making your love life the best part of your life, please consider subscribing.

And Join our conversation on social media.

Facebook https://www.facebook.com/aborrello2
Instagram https://www.instagram.com/edatingdr/
Twitter https://twitter.com/eDatingDr

Are you interested in dating advice for women or advice on relationship problems? If so, you have found the dating coach for you. This channel is all about love tips, relationships and love, relationship problems and signs he likes you. Essentially, this channel is focused on love advice and helping you understand what men want. Please join our conversations in the video comment sections.

Links:
AskDrAntonio.com: https://www.AskDrAntonio.com/yt
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/aborrello2
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/edatingdr/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/eDatingDr

title: Samen Meer Beleven
author: doubtfullinea
description:
In Samen Meer Beleven draait alles om de momenten die we samen creëren. In een druk dagelijks leven schieten quality time, spontane plannen en echte gesprekken er gemakkelijk bij in. Deze podcast onderzoekt hoe stellen, vrienden, gezinnen en families op eenvoudige manieren meer tijd voor elkaar kunnen maken en van gewone dagen bijzondere herinneringen kunnen maken.Elke aflevering behandelt een herkenbaar thema rondom samen zijn: van originele date-ideeën en gezellige activiteiten thuis tot spontane uitstapjes, nieuwe tradities, schermvrije avonden en kleine avonturen waarvoor je geen groot budget nodig hebt.

Halverwege de serieomschrijving komt ook het idee van een Cadeau voor koppels mooi naar voren: iets tastbaars waarmee je niet alleen een moment geeft, maar juist inspiratie om samen nieuwe momenten te creëren. Het gaat daarbij niet om de waarde van het cadeau, maar om de herinneringen die er uiteindelijk uit ontstaan.De podcast sluit aan bij de gedachte achter Samen Uit, Samen Thuis: bewust tijd maken voor elkaar, nieuwe activiteiten ontdekken en herinneringen bewaren. Het boek bevat meer dan 100 activiteiten en biedt daarnaast ruimte om foto's, grappige momenten, favoriete details, quotes en eigen avonturen vast te leggen.

Doel van de podcastHet doel van de serie is luisteraars inspireren om minder op automatische piloot te leven en vaker bewust samen iets te ondernemen. De afleveringen geven praktische ideeën die gemakkelijk thuis of buiten de deur kunnen worden uitgevoerd.De podcast richt zich niet alleen op romantische koppels. Ook vrienden, vriendinnen, gezinnen, broers en zussen en andere mensen die samen herinneringen willen maken, kunnen inspiratie uit de afleveringen halen.

title: ...But I'm Probably Right
author: Pierre Robinson
description: Sports, Entertainment, Politics. I say what everyone else is afraid to say!

title: Structure Y | Movies, AI & Systems
author: Structure Y
description:
Structure Y is a podcast about movies, AI, technology, companies, and culture — not just what happened, but why the system behind it works the way it does.
Each episode starts with a simple question and explores the structure underneath: how franchises grow, why companies make certain choices, how technology changes creative work, and how systems shape what we see.
Adapted from original essays and analysis by Structure Y.
AI-generated narration is used in this podcast.

title: Become The Obvious Choice
author: STORY22
description:
Why do customers choose one business over another? Become The Obvious Choice brings together practical conversations about what makes businesses worth buying from, working for and recommending. 
Hosted by STORY22, the podcast explores the real drivers behind business growth, from clear messaging and marketing to customer experience, culture, leadership, systems and AI. Expect honest conversations, useful ideas and practical lessons you can take back into your own business.

title: Spreadsheet Fantasy Basketball
author: Karan Talwar
description: Spreadsheet Fantasy Basketball is here to help you win your leagues and have fun along the way. Hosted by Karan Talwar, a long-time fantasy basketball player with multiple trophies in highly competitive leagues, the show combines strong takes with the data to back them up. Learn how to read beyond the NBA box score, spot real changes in minutes and roles, and make smarter calls on drafts, waiver wire, trades, buy-lows, sell-highs, punting and schedule strategy to get the edge all season long.

title: Captain's Log: A Petey the Pirate Podcast
author: Petey the Pirate
description: Captain Petey's logbook is full of adventures from his pirate days, the real stuant before the gadgets and gizmos. Follow him chasing the scattered pieces of Neptune's Compass, one entry at a time, as old rivals, older enemies, and a few unexpected friends keep getting in his way. New entries drop regularly, start at Episode 1.

title: Michigan's Forgotten
author: AiDN Studios
description: The History You Didn't Know. The Stories You Won't Forget

title: The Let Down Podcast
author: LET DOWN
description:
**The Letdown Podcast**
The Letdown is a fireside-style podcast hosted by Chris Lafleur, Justin Harrison and Misha Koroscil (the LETDOWN CREW), diving into real conversations around archery, bowhunting, and competition. From top shooters to everyday grinders, we talk about the wins, the struggles, and everything in between. No highlight reels — just honest stories, lessons learned, and the moments that stick long after the shot. If you live for the range or the woods, you’re in the right place.

title: Kirk Gross Blueprint
author: Kirk Gross Company
description:
Great projects are about more than plans on paper. Kirk Gross Blueprint, a podcast from Kirk Gross Company, explores the people, decisions, and ideas behind successful commercial spaces. From planning and design to construction and furnishings, each episode shares practical insights, project stories, and industry perspectives from the professionals who bring spaces to life.
Follow the Kirk Gross Blueprint podcast for more conversations about what goes into building great spaces.

title: The OBGMs: BAND PRACTICE
author: The OBGMs
description: Join Denz, Cola, and Joey for their weekly podcast as they discuss music, culture, and life as we know it.

title: One Thousand and 2 Matches Everybody Should See
author: Joseph Martinez
description:
*1002 Matches Everybody Should See* brings you ringside with lifelong wrestling fans, brothers, and tag team partners Martin Cisco and Ramon “Monchy” Silver. From legendary classics to overlooked gems, they revisit the matches, stories, and personalities that made them love wrestling—with plenty of laughs and brotherly debate along the way.
*Does your match make the list?*
Brought to you by Heel Clothing — HeelClothing.com.

title: Koast to Coast | Kiko Suarez & Guaje Rodriguez
author: Francisco Suarez and Cesar Rodriguez
description:
Koast to Coast is a football podcast hosted by Kiko and Guaje, two fans on opposite sides of the country with two very different football allegiances: Real Madrid and Bayern Munich.
From LaLiga and the Bundesliga to the Champions League, Premier League, transfers, predictions, debates, reactions and everything happening across world football, Koast to Coast is where the arguments, hot takes and real fan reactions live.
New episodes feature match reactions, weekly predictions, Champions League talk, football debates and plenty of disagreements along the way.
Two coasts. Two clubs. One football podcast.
Follow the show and join us every week on Koast to Coast.

title: This Week in VGM
author: Zack!
description: A weekly look into video game history and the music and composers who drive it. Each week we take a quick look at a game and a soundtrack on the anniversary of its release, and give fun facts about the game and its composers.

title: The Integrative Medicine Roundtable
author: DrTalks
description: The Integrative Medicine Roundtable: Where Practitioners Lead brings together physicians, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, health coaches, nutritionists, and functional medicine providers for peer-to-peer conversations about the future of healthcare. Hosted by the North Carolina Integrative Medical Society (NCIMS), each episode explores clinical insights, emerging research, practice growth, and real-world lessons from practitioners leading the integrative medicine movement. Learn, connect, and grow alongside a community that shares your vision for patient care.

title: MOVING IN: A Closed Loop Home Guide
author: Crystal Bright
description: Moving In: A Closed Loop Home Guide is a practical, step-by-step podcast for anyone planning a move or setting up a new home. Listen while you pack, paint, unpack, organize, and figure out what belongs where. Each episode helps you decide what to do first, what can wait, and how to set up your home around the way you actually live—not just the way rooms are “supposed” to work. Created by interior designer Crystal Bright, author of The Closed Loop Home.

title: More than a Voice
author: Dave Armstrong
description:
More Than a Voice is the podcast that goes beyond the microphone to discover the person behind the voice.
Hosted by Irish voice actor David Armstrong, each episode features an open and engaging conversation with voice actors from across the industry, exploring their journeys, experiences, creativity and the realities of building a career behind the mic.
From animation, gaming and audiobooks to commercials, narration and beyond, we talk about the work — but more importantly, the people who bring those voices to life.

title: Makers & Shapers
author: Makers & Shapers
description:
Makers & Shapers is the podcast for women building businesses that matter - with courage, integrity, and real impact.

Hosted by Rebecca Downie and Megha Singh, founders of the Makers & Shapers Awards, we sit down with award winners, judges, sponsors, and community leaders to hear the real stories behind what they've built: the risks, the setbacks, and the decisions nobody else sees.

Because the women making the biggest difference aren't always the ones making the most noise.

Real talk on business, money, visibility, leadership, and what it actually takes to build something that lasts - for female founders and business leaders in Singapore and beyond.

Applications for the 2027 Awards open 4 January. To apply, nominate, sponsor, or judge, head to makersandshapers.com.

Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming next.

title: From Parts Unknown: The Podcast
author: George Sirois
description: From Parts Unknown: The Podcast is a look behind the scenes of over 30 years of development for the story that would become From Parts Unknown. From a video game concept to a treatment of a script to several screenplay drafts to one novel to a rewritten and enlarged story that would be five smaller books, then changing one more time to three books, this has been a tremendous journey and I look forward to sharing it with you.

title: Quiet on The Set Reviews
author: mavance85
description: just 2 best friends who love all things horror!!!

title: The Big Exclusive Podcast
author: Shannon Big Exclusive Reynolds
description:
The Big Exclusive Podcast is a bold, unfiltered talk show hosted by Big Exclusive alongside cohost The Angry OG, covering relationships, culture, current events, entertainment, social issues, and everyday life from a perspective that is honest, funny, and unapologetically real.

Together, Big Exclusive and The Angry OG create a space where difficult conversations aren't avoided. From the modern dating game and the battle of the sexes to controversial cultural topics, celebrity news, money, relationships, and the issues people debate every day, the show brings different perspectives to the table and lets the conversation get real.

The Big Exclusive Podcast isn't about telling you what to think. It's about asking the questions that make you think, laugh, debate, and sometimes say, "Hold up... I never looked at it like that."

Real conversations. Real opinions. No safe answers.

The Big Exclusive Podcast. Where the conversation gets exclusive.

title: Contorni
author: Chora Media - Eugenio Signoroni
description:
Il cibo è molto di più di quello che troviamo sulla tavola: rappresenta un punto di osservazione unico per raccontare la realtà che ci circonda. Agricoltura, filiere, lavoro, impatto ambientale. E poi scambi commerciali, rapporti fra stati, ma anche storia, piacere, cultura del gusto e molto altro.


“Contorni” è il podcast che ogni settimana parla di cibo attraverso i fatti del mondo, e dei fatti del mondo attraverso il cibo. Un progetto di Chora Media realizzato con il sostegno di Breaders, scritto e condotto da Eugenio Signoroni.

title: Times Table in the Car
author: Klassic Studios pty. ltd.
description:
A great way to learn your times table while travelling in the car!

Each day is a new times table (2 to 12). Every episode will randomize the questions, so that it's not in order. We also give helpful tips and tricks to remember the tricky ones!

For example, 3 times table will be:
4x3
9x3
2x3
10x3 etc.

Happy learning!

title: Capital Horizon
author: Anthony Shires
description:
Capital Horizon is a podcast for curious minds who want to understand the world of business, investing, money, and financial growth.
Each episode explores business strategies, investment principles, market trends, entrepreneurship, wealth-building ideas, and the real-world factors that influence financial decisions. From beginner-friendly investing concepts to deeper conversations about companies, markets, and economic opportunities, Capital Horizon makes complex financial topics easier to understand.
Whether you're an aspiring entrepreneur, an investor, a business professional, or simply interested in building a stronger financial future, this podcast brings practical insights and fresh perspectives to help you think smarter about money and business.
Capital Horizon — Explore Business. Understand Markets. Build Your Financial Future.

title: The Amazing Grace Fellowship Podcast
author: Media
description: The official weekly sermon podcast from Amazing Grace Fellowship in Twin Falls, Idaho led by Pastor Lynn Schaal.

title: The Practiced Word
author: Matthew Hilley
description: The Practiced Word is a Christian podcast about Christian life coaching, behavior change, and practical Christian living. Each episode connects one Bible passage with one everyday challenge, then offers one practical step to practice during the week. We explore Christian habits, follow through, difficult conversations, life decisions, boundaries, rest, priorities, and leadership. Scripture guides the direction, while behavior science helps us understand the patterns, routines, and circumstances that make change easier or harder. If you are exploring faith based life coaching or looking for an online Christian life coach, you will find clear, thoughtful conversations here. The show also supports Christian growth and practical everyday decisions. Hosted by The Practiced Word team with thoughtful guests, the podcast helps turn reflection into action without pressure or unrealistic promises. This is educational content, not counseling, therapy, medical care, or addiction treatment. Subscribe for practical Christian guidance, Christian coaching insights, and faith for the life you are actually living.

title: The Start Right Podcast
author: Start Right Helper by Jennifer
description: You hired a helper, and nobody handed you a manual. Start Right is for employers of domestic helpers who want a household that runs properly, without the guesswork, the guilt or the second-guessing. Every episode gives you one clear system you can use this week. No blame. No fluff. No lectures about gratitude. Just what works in a real house, from somebody who has made most of these mistakes personally. Free helper risk check, ten questions and two minutes, at startrighthelper.com.

title: TheUnravel
author: Prisca Attah
description:
We don't experience life as it is. We experience the stories we build around it.

TheUnravel is a podcast about the ideas, experiences, beliefs, and stories that quietly shape the way we see ourselves and the lives we build.


Hosted by Prisca Attah, TheUnraveler, each episode pulls on one thread: faith, family, business, money, identity, ambition, relationships, personal growth, and the unexpected lessons hidden inside ordinary experiences.


Sometimes one small thread is all it takes to unravel an idea you've carried for years.

This is a space to pause, question, reflect, and see what is underneath the story.

Because understanding doesn't always arrive all at once. 


It unfolds.


Pull one thread.

title: The Dungeon Crawlers Podcast
author: Dungeon Crawlers
description:
Dungeon Crawlers is a gritty, fast-paced actual-play campaign inspired by lethal, rogue-like dungeon runs. Each mini-season, two complete strangers are thrown into an unforgiving, homebrewed labyrinth. They must work together, solve brutal environmental puzzles, and survive the terrifying trials orchestrated by the Overseer. If they escape, they win; if they die, the season ends, and a new duo enters the maze.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Write Balance
author: Melissa
description: A biweekly podcast on finding balance and joy in writing and the creative process, hosted by writers and long-time friends Melissa Burkart and Kathleen Kayembe.

title: Dream Chasing
author: Bob Weis and Jody Maberry
description: Bob Weis knows what it takes to build a dream. As retired president of Walt Disney Imagineering, he led the creative teams behind some of the world's most ambitious experiences. In the Dream Chasing podcast, Bob and Jody Maberry sit down with extraordinary  whose talent, drive, and passion have turned big ideas into experiences that change the way we work, play, and live. Along the way, they dig into the creative process, the challenges that nearly stopped them, and the lessons that apply to anyone with a dream worth chasing.

title: Rated H
author: Annenberg School for Communication
description: Rated H tells the story of how Home Box Office (HBO) transformed from a cash-bleeding, scrappy startup into a global cultural force. The series traces the rise of a network that refused to play by traditional rules, betting everything on risk, defiance, and pushing the limits of what television audiences were allowed to see. Across four episodes, Rated H describes not only HBO's groundbreaking creative leaps, but also its high-stakes battles for survival, its uninhibited early office culture, and the critical question of who got to speak and who got left out. From near-collapse to rebellious programming and the legal battles that shaped the streaming era, its story became a masterclass in reinvention.

title: Daily English Pod
author: Jale Qaraqan
description:
Daily English Pod is a space for learning English beyond grammar and textbooks.

During the week, you’ll learn practical vocabulary, expressions, idioms, and real-life English- the language people actually use in everyday conversations, emotions, and work.


On weekends, we slow down. Through ideas from psychology, philosophy, and real human experience, we explore language as a way to better understand life, emotions, identity, and growth.


This podcast is created by Jale, an English teacher with 13 years of teaching experience and a Master’s degree in English language and literature based in Canada, who teaches with patience, clarity, and care, and believes learning works best when students feel seen, respected, and safe to think aloud.


The goal is simple but meaningful: to help you understand English deeply, use it confidently, and connect it to your real life. English here is not just a skill. It’s a gentle companion for clearer thinking, honest expression, and deeper human connection.

title: "the good work talk show" with mallory contois
author: Mallory Contois
description:
"the good work talk show" is a deeply honest exploration of work and how it can be a tool for discovering and becoming your best self.

Hosted by mallory contois, each episode is a conversation with someone whose career you may have admired from afar, without knowing the full picture. mallory and her guests get into the real decisions, detours, and tradeoffs they made along the way.

Season 01 is presented by Granola.

Get every episode in your inbox with mallory's notes and takeaways: http://www.watchgoodwork.com

title: The Becky and Cam Show
author: Becky Lucas and Cameron James
description:
Hi, this is a comedy show by comedians and best friends, Becky Lucas and Cameron James.

Chit chat. Improvised characters. Sometimes calls from listeners. Sometimes guests. Sometimes not.


Send us a voicemail, ask a question, or share an anonymous secret here: https://www.speakpipe.com/BeckyAndCam


Funny since day dot (tm).

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Wind Down
author: Deej
description: Welcome to The Wind Down, a space where you can pause, breathe, and let the noise of the day gently fade away. Through calming meditations and sincere words of support, I want you to find comfort, reassurance, and the opportunity to reconnect with yourself. Most importantly, you'll be reminded that you matter and that you are never alone.

title: This Might Help with Matt Braunger
author: Matt Braunger
description: This Might Help with Matt Braunger is the third and final evolution of comedian Matt Braunger's advice podcast. Matt Braunger and guest listen to messages left by everyday people who need advice, on the spot. No googling, no BS, and all entertaining. Got a problem? Need a laugh? This Might Help. Call Matt's advice line 323-763-0228.

title: Thought of the Day
author: Dr. Gary Slone
description: Dr. Gary gives daily devotionals to inspire and uplift.

title: Thoughts of a Wordinary Girl
author: Sheela
description: Thought provoking social commentary

title: Only a Dog; a Story of the Great War (A Heartfelt Tale)
author: Bertha Whitridge Smith
description:
When the world erupts into chaos, an Irish Terrier named Army sets off on a perilous journey to find his young master, Peter Rice. In "Only a Dog; a Story of the Great War," Bertha Whitridge Smith captures the raw emotions and harrowing experiences of a canine hero navigating the treacherous landscapes of World War I. As Germans invade his home, Army's loyalty drives him into No Man's Land, where he faces bullets and despair but also encounters unexpected courage and friendship.

Through Army's eyes, listeners will experience the brutal realities of war, the bond between soldier and dog, and the resilience of the spirit in the face of unimaginable odds. This audiobook invites you to witness not only the horrors of battle but also the moments of tenderness that define loyalty and sacrifice.

As Army follows Private Pete through the mud and chaos of the front lines, he becomes a symbol of hope and love amid despair. Will their bond survive the trials of war, or will fate separate them forever? With each chapter, you’ll be drawn deeper into a tale that celebrates the unbreakable connection between humans and their four-legged companions. Perfect for listeners who appreciate stories of bravery, loyalty, and the indomitable will to survive, this audiobook is a heartfelt tribute to the unsung heroes of history.

title: Blood Between Us
author: Deanne & Madyline Price
description:
Blood Between Us is a mother-and-daughter true-crime podcast.
Together we dig into murder cases where family is not the background—it’s the wound. Mothers and daughters. Blood relatives. The people who should have been safe. The people who weren’t.
Each episode we walk a case from the first crack in the story to the last official version of the truth. What the records say. What the family said. What still doesn’t sit right. We talk it through the way we actually talk: one of us pushing for the facts, the other pulling at the feeling underneath them.
This is not shock for shock’s sake. We name victims. We stay with the people left behind. We do not treat grief like a plot twist.
If you listen for careful case work, family dynamics, and the quiet places a murder leaves behind, you’re in the right place.
New cases. Old blood. The secrets don’t stay in the ground.
Blood Between Us.

title: #WalkAway Campaign Debates
author: #WalkAway Campaign With Brandon Straka
description: A debate series produced by the #WalkAway Campaign and hosted by Brandon Straka, exploring differing perspectives within the conservative movement. Each episode brings together guests representing a range of viewpoints to discuss politics, policy, strategy, and the future direction of conservatism in America. From grassroots activists to political commentators, these conversations dive deep into the debates shaping the right — and what they mean for the country.

title: The Intelligent Life
author: Yoav Wachsman
description:
Welcome to The Intelligent Life podcast, the show that helps people develop life, interpersonal, and financial skills to transform their lives. Each episode dives into one powerful skill that can help you live life intelligently. Listeners learn ways to improve their lives based on proven research. The show is hosted by Yoav Wachsman, a professor at Coastal Carolina University.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Gear Up with Mo
author: Mo
description: Gear Up with Mo dives deep into the technical design, real-world performance, and material science behind the outdoor equipment keeping us alive and comfortable in the backcountry.

title: Nonsense History
author: Matt and Zaid
description: Nonsense History From mundane to the wild

title: Tell Me I'm Wrong
author: Tania Torres & Giny Daniel
description:
We're two best friends, chronic over-thinkers,  recovering people-pleasers and spend an alarming amount of time analyzing our thoughts and choices in life. 

 
For years we've spent hours and hours talking about relationships, friendships, careers, money, getting older, bad decisions, sex (and how we have VERY different ideas of what good and bad sex is) and just other unhinged sh*t that we usually only say to each other... and now we're saying it all out loud with you!
 
Every week, we overshare, argue our completely unsolicited opinions, call each other on our bullshit and give our best attempt to answer life's big questions... like: What age are we supposed to know what the f*ck we're doing? Is dating new people worth it? Are we the problem? Did we used to be witches in another life? You know the hard questions...


Everyone has intrusive thoughts - ours just needed a microphone- tell me I’m wrong!!!!

title: Vivir en Cristo: Reflexiones Diarias
author: Jesús
description: ¡Hola! Soy el Dr. Jesús D. Díaz, un  creador de contenido Católico dedicado a compartir reflexiones sobre la fe ✝️, la espiritualidad 🕊️ y la belleza de vivir una vida centrada en Cristo. Mi misión es inspirar a otros a profundizar su relación con Dios y encontrar paz en su vida diaria. 🌼

title: Project Freedom Weekly Groundings
author: Molly
description: Private Podcast for 2026 Project Freedom

title: Due Diligence with Daniel Flynn
author: DanielFlynn.RI
description:
Most deals look great until you pop the hood. Due Diligence with Daniel Flynn delivers tactical, no-fluff underwriting for Rhode Island real estate investors.
What we break down:
• On vs. Off-Market: Dissecting live MLS listings, wholesale deals, and direct sourcing across RI
• Underwriting: Cap rates, cash-on-cash return, ARV, and DSCR
• Local Dynamics: Neighborhood trends, zoning shifts, and rental demand
• Risk: Spotting red flags in a pro forma before risking capital
No hype. Just disciplined property analysis for investors who care about the balance sheet.

title: No Map, Lead Anyway!
author: Luba Fateeva & Lilia Toftoul
description: "No Map, Lead Anyway" There's rarely a map for the next step. But you can still lead. It is a podcast for anyone navigating a career transition: stepping into a bigger role, a new country, a new culture or a new level of responsibility, where the old playbook no longer applies. You'll hear: why transitions succeed or fail, the inner side of leadership change: identity, energy and influence, practical strategies for women leaders building international careers, what organisations and HR leaders can do to support leaders better.

title: Crime Stories
author: Excel
description:
Crime Stories takes you deep into the world of true crime, uncovering chilling cases, mysterious disappearances, unsolved investigations, shocking crimes, and the stories behind the headlines.
From cold cases and courtroom mysteries to criminal investigations and unexpected twists, each episode explores the evidence, key events, and unanswered questions surrounding some of the most compelling cases.
🔎 Real cases. Unanswered questions. Stories that stay with you.

title: Real Talk
author: LVHS_OnAir
description:
Real Talk with host Oliver Rambo. 
Produced by Leavenworth Athletics. 
Discussions about Leavenworth sports teams.

title: Never Too Late to Dream
author: Caroline Buist
description: Real, inspiring stories from late bloomers, who followed their dreams and found their version of success in their 40s, 50s, 60s and beyond, despite wobbles, challenges and setbacks.

title: Reserve the Right Podcast
author: Reserve the Right
description:
Reserve the Right is Anda Gansca thinking out loud about marketing, AI, and whatever else is worth arguing about that week. The name is the idea: she reserves the right to have an opinion today and change it later when she learns something new.
Strong opinions, loosely held. Every episode takes a real POV, grounded in what the data is actually showing, not the safe version everyone else is saying. No hedging, no "it depends," just a take you can push back on.
New episodes every other week, alongside the newsletter of the same name.

title: The Press Reset Podcast
author: UK Construction Week Birmingham
description: Welcome to the Press Reset podcast series from UK Construction Week Birmingham (UKCW), a new series of insightful podcasts featuring thought leaders from the UK construction industry, for a deep dive into the sector’s key issues and how to resolve them.  Hosted by Martin Hurn, UKCW Birmingham Editorial Director, Press Reset will release several podcasts each week in the lead-up to the three-day event itself, which runs at the NEC from 29th September to 1st October.

title: Strange Systems
author: Elsewhere Works
description:
Strange Systems is a podcast about art, creativity and the spaces in between, exploring what happens when human intuition meets machine intelligence. Through conversations, experiments and creative detours, it follows the strange new forms that emerge from contact between incompatible systems. 
Produced by Elsewhere Works.
The system does not guarantee understanding.
It creates the possibility of contact.

title: Shit Scared with Heidi Anderson
author: Heidi Anderson
description:
Shit Scared is the stuff we're all shit scared to say out loud.
Ever looked at someone and thought, "How the fuck are they so brave?"
Well, here's a little secret. They're probably shit scared too.
Join Heidi Anderson for hilarious, raw and sometimes deeply uncomfortable conversations. From sex, relationships and body image... to grief, failure and the fear of what everyone else thinks. Nothing's off-limits.
We'll laugh, we'll cry, we'll probably overshare, and we'll do the scary stuff together.
Consider this your permission slip to be shit scared and do it anyway. 💩

title: Actually, Same
author: Dani-Rae Strohminger
description: Honest conversations about confidence, burnout, motherhood, grief, identity, and learning to trust yourself again. If you have ever wondered, "Is it just me?".... actually, same.

title: Infrared Intel
author: DNT Optics Podcast
description: Infrared Intel, presented by DNT Optics, is a podcast for the hunting industry at large. We sit down with hunters, guides, and industry insiders from brands across the outdoor world to talk night hunting, thermal and night vision technology, and where the industry is headed — the gear, the tactics, and the stories behind it all.

title: AAAI Fitness Podcast
author: AAAI Fitness
description:
The AAAI Fitness Podcast delivers practical education, expert interviews, and real-world insights for personal trainers, group fitness instructors, and fitness professionals. Topics include exercise science, coaching, business, health, and career development.
How to become a personal trainer and group fitness instructor: https://aaaifitness.com/

We’ll speak with organizers, activists, volunteers, social entrepreneurs, and changemakers about the experiences that shaped them, the communities that changed them, and the choices that turned concern into commitment.

In a planet upended by war, strife, injustice and darkness; one where we often find ourselves in dispair  complaining, much like Frodo from Tolkein’s world  "I wish it need not have happened in my time," to which the wise Galdalf replies "So do I, and so do all who live to see such times. author: Radio Primavera Sound
description: L’any 1958, un bosc de Valls va acollir la primera i única edició del Concurs d’Objectes Insòlits. Destinat a nois i noies menors de 14 anys, aquesta competició els convidava a presentar-hi fins a tres objectes “extrets directament de l’entorn” com pedres, arrels o troncs, que destaquessin per tenir “un valor propi de forma i color”. I així va ser com un grup de preadolescents catalans de postguerra es van convertir en artistes per un dia. Aquest pòdcast recupera el nom del singular concurs d'art infantil perquè aspira a compartir-ne la missió: afinar la mirada, trobar art a tot arreu i compartir-ho amb els altres. En comptes d'un bosc, ho farem a internet!

description: Most of what we accept as normal is just conditioning. Delivering raw, grounded, and independent perspectives, we challenge conventional narratives and seek out the truths people rarely talk about. Whether unraveling a late-night dream or breaking down the machinery of authority, pull up a chair, leave the dogma at the door, and see the world as it actually is.

title: American Pie: gli USA alla prova del Midterm
author: OnePodcast
description:
Le elezioni di metà mandato del prossimo 3 novembre sono al centro del racconto di due italiani che, per motivi diversi, vivono negli Stati Uniti. Marina Viola, milanese ma cittadina USA da oltre trent’anni, e Federico Bernocchi, ancora ospite nel Paese, seguono il percorso verso un voto che non sceglierà un nuovo presidente (Trump rimarrà comunque in carica per altri due anni), ma che potrebbe rivelarsi decisivo per gli equilibri politici degli Stati Uniti e per il futuro della democrazia americana.


Settimana dopo settimana, politica, economia, guerre, cultura, libertà e diritti diventano le chiavi per capire un Paese attraversato da profonde divisioni. Un racconto dall’interno, tra cronaca, analisi e vita quotidiana, fino alle elezioni e a ciò che succederà dopo. Un "dopo" che spaventa non pochi elettori.

Per capire insieme dove sta andando l’America, cosa queste elezioni possono cambiare e che conseguenze avranno per tutto l’Occidente.

Recorded at key convenings and beyond, the podcast features honest conversations with youth leaders, practitioners, policymakers, and organizations driving the Youth, Peace and Security (YPS) agenda. Each episode captures real-time insights from the rooms where decisions are made — and translates them into accessible, human stories.

Blending audio, video, and editorial storytelling, YPS Amplify Magazine documents ideas, people, and moments that move youth participation forward — beyond reports, beyond meetings, and beyond the mic.

Grounded in the principles of UN Security Council Resolution 2250, the magazine podcast contributes to advancing youth participation, prevention, partnerships, and inclusive peacebuilding across the continent.

description:
The History of Furries Podcast, hosted by Josh Linsk, explores the origins, evolution, culture, art, communities, controversies, and personalities that shaped the furry fandom. From early anthropomorphic characters in mythology, literature, animation, comics, and science fiction to the rise of modern furry conventions, online communities, fursuiting, digital art, and social media, each episode examines how the fandom developed into a global subculture.

The podcast looks at major milestones, influential artists and creators, early fan groups, convention history, internet culture, terminology, costume design, roleplay, identity, media coverage, community debates, and the changing public perception of furries. It also explores the relationship between furry culture and animation, gaming, fantasy, science fiction, LGBTQ+ communities, online creativity, and broader fandom history.

Hosted by Josh Linsk, The History of Furries Podcast takes a detailed, curious, and often entertaining look at one of the internet era’s most distinctive communities—how it began, how it changed, and why it continues to grow.

description: We created this platform with one purpose in mind: to give a voice to the stories that are often carried quietly. title: Brain Signals
author: David Iams
description:
Brain Signals is a new webinar and podcast series designed to make neuroregulation more
visible, accessible, and relevant. Neuroregulation refers to a constellation of techniques and
tools that measure and enhance brain performance to support health and functioning.

Through engaging conversations with providers and researchers, the series will explore why
neurotherapy and neuroregulation matter—for personal, clinical, and collective wellbeing. In
addition to chatting with experts, everyday people will share their personal stories of how
neuroregulation has positively changed their lives.

Host David Ims (a licensed mental health counselor and neuroregulation specialist) will highlight
the “why” behind neuroregulation, and the impacts of retraining the brain to sharpen focus, lift
mood, ease worry, balance emotion, or improve sleep.

With the right mixture of data, research, and technology, anyone’s brain signals offer insights
into one’s self-understanding. This can be deployed to strengthen mental resilience and
regulation, complementary of personal background or experiences.

On Brain Signals, you will hear how your neural hardware and mental software interact. If you
have ever wondered how you can gently support your brain to work better in daily life and
improve your mental health and overall wellness, this one is for you. Stay tuned!

title: Medi-Culture Conversations
author: Team London Bridge
description:
Medi-Culture Conversations is the official podcast of the Medi-Culture Festival, celebrating health, science and wellbeing in the heart of London Bridge. Across a series of short episodes, we go beyond the festival programme to explore the ideas, research and people behind the events. From gut health and nutrition to creativity, movement and laughter, each conversation uncovers the science and stories shaping how we understand wellbeing today.

Hosted by Team London Bridge, the podcast features interviews with festival facilitators, researchers and practitioners. Together, we explore how culture, creativity and community can support healthier lives, and why London Bridge has long been a place where medicine and innovation meet. Whether you are attending the festival or simply curious about the intersection of health and culture, Medi-Culture Conversations offers a space to slow down, learn something new, and connect with the ideas behind the programme.

title: Market Mix
author: RBC Global Asset Management (U.S.) Inc.
description:
The Market Mix, from RBC Global Asset Management (US), is for institutional investors, financial advisors, consultants, and investment professionals. Hosted by Tim Leary, the show explores where markets intersect — bringing together expert perspectives on macroeconomics, policy, public and private markets, and the global forces shaping investment decisions.
Economic developments influence policy. Policy shapes markets. Public and private assets respond to global events in different ways. Understanding how those forces connect is essential for making informed investment decisions. Through thoughtful conversations with specialists and respected industry leaders, the Market Mix follows the flow of capital across asset classes — where it's going, where it's coming from, where there's value, and where the value traps are hiding.
The "Mix" is the point. Different topics. Different assets. Different points of view. From fixed income and equities to alternatives and cross-industry themes, each episode gives you a 360-degree view of the topics driving where capital flows and the returns that follow.

title: THE PROTEIN PULSE PODCAST — BRASIL
author: Shawn Sparks
description: O The Protein Pulse Podcast — Brasil, apresentado por Shawn Sparks, oferece inteligência de mercado e análises comerciais sobre os mercados de proteínas animais nos Estados Unidos e no mundo. Com mais de 25 anos de experiência no setor, Shawn compartilha sua perspectiva sobre os mercados de carne bovina, suína e de frango, custos de alimentação animal, comércio internacional e tendências da indústria. Cada episódio transforma dados do USDA, preços de mercado, tendências de produção e abate, importações, exportações e acontecimentos econômicos em informações práticas para compradores, fornecedores, frigoríficos, traders e executivos do setor. Com atenção especial às relações comerciais entre o Brasil e os Estados Unidos, o programa acompanha os acontecimentos que influenciam os fluxos internacionais de proteínas, os preços, as margens e as oportunidades comerciais. title: Uncertain Ground
author: Tracy & Taura
description:
What happens when something you thought you understood starts to look different?
Uncertain Ground is a podcast about the questions that emerge when life doesn’t fit neatly into what we thought we knew.
Hosted by friends Tracy and Taura, each conversation starts with a question—with curiosity. It might be triggered by a story, a recent experience, or something they see differently than they did before.
They don’t come to the conversation with the answer. They come curious about the question itself, following it wherever it leads and discovering what they might see differently along the way.
Sometimes the questions are personal. Sometimes they’re about the world around us. Sometimes they’re simply questions that won’t let go.
The point isn’t to arrive at certainty. It’s to make room for another perspective, stay open to what we might be missing, and perhaps move through the world a little more thoughtfully.
A new conversation launches every Tuesday.
Listen, follow, subscribe, and share Uncertain Ground wherever you listen to podcasts.
These aren’t conversations about having the right answer. They’re about being willing to ask a different question, consider another perspective, and stay curious when things get complicated.
Because sometimes, questioning what we think we know changes more than our perspective. It changes how we move through the world.
Sometimes we start with something that happened to one of us. Sometimes it’s a story, an idea, a cultural moment, or a question we can’t quite shake. Wherever we begin, we follow the conversation and see where it takes us.
The goal isn’t certainty. It’s becoming a little more comfortable with the questions—and a little more thoughtful about how we live with them.
If you’ve ever found yourself thinking, “Wait… is there another way to look at this?” you’ll feel at home here.
Come sit with us. We start a new conversation every Tuesday.
Follow, subscribe, and share Uncertain Ground wherever you listen to podcasts.

title: AI Native Cybersecurity
author: Terra Security
description:
Cybersecurity is changing faster than the playbooks designed to protect it.


AI Native Cybersecurity goes inside the minds of security professionals who think like adversaries, challenging assumptions, testing continuously, and finding weaknesses before attackers do.


Each episode features candid conversations with cybersecurity leaders and practitioners who are rethinking what offensive security looks like in the AI era. No vendor pitches. No recycled talking points. No war stories dressed up as thought leadership. Just practitioners comparing notes on the work: what’s changing, what’s failing, what’s working, and what security teams need to be paying attention to next.


Because when AI accelerates development, expands attack surfaces, and changes adversaries' capabilities, waiting to be attacked isn’t a strategy.


Think like the adversary. 


Find the weakness first.


Offense is the new Defense.


Welcome to AI Native Cybersecurity, powered by Terra Security.

description:

title: Build To Run
author: Michael Trampetti
description:
Build to Run is for the contractor who's still the estimator, the fixer, and the guy everyone calls when a job goes sideways — GCs, specialty contractors, subcontractors, who are tired of being the person their entire company depends on. 


Mike Trampetti gets into what actually eats up a contractor's week: estimates only the owner can price, jobs that go sideways, teams that can't make decisions, and businesses that stall the second the owner steps away. 


Some episodes are a problem that already got fixed, told straight. 

Some are where business owners work through real problems with Mike while the answer is being figured out. 

No textbook advice. Just honest conversations about building a construction company that can scale without everything running through you. 


Built to Scale. Wired to Last.

Chris and Paul Mathurin sit down with entrepreneurs, operators, and people who bet on themselves, and ask the questions that usually get skipped. Not the highlight reel. The part where money got tight, the hire didn't work out, and quitting would have been the reasonable thing to do.

description:
The Women's Empowerment Series revisits meaningful conversations with inspiring voices who have shared their stories, wisdom, and experiences around growth, purpose, resilience, leadership, and life.

Hosted by Rebecca Hall Gruyter, each episode brings these powerful conversations back into the spotlight, offering timeless insights and encouragement that remain relevant today.

From personal growth and relationships to wellness, business, leadership, and life transitions, these conversations invite you to reflect, reconnect with what matters, and move forward with greater clarity and confidence.

title: If These Walls Could COOK
author: Stephen Found
description:
If These Walls Could Cook is a podcast about remarkable places, the food connected to them, and the wonderfully strange people and stories you find when you start poking around.


Hosted by Stephen Found, founder of GATHER, each episode starts at a table with a story and follows the food wherever it leads. Along the way, Stephen talks with farmers, cooks, craftspeople, historians, tradesmen, owners, and local characters to uncover what people grew, cooked, ate, drank, built, preserved, and occasionally got completely wrong.


Some stories are historic. Some are unexpected. Some are funny. Most are a little of all three. If These Walls Could Cook is less about dates and dusty facts, and more about discovering how food connects us to place, culture, and one another.

Come hungry. Curiosity helps.

title: Uncensored Desire
author: קול האוניברסיטה | AudioVersity
description:
We talk about sex, love, and dating all the time, but how honest are we really being?
Hosted by Romeo Ari Perlman, Uncensored Desire explores what happens beneath the surface of our intimate lives: the things we want, the truths we hide, the boundaries we negotiate, and the stories we tell ourselves and one another.
Through candid, curious, and sometimes provocative conversations with experts and compelling voices, the podcast questions the social rules and personal beliefs shaping how we experience attraction, pleasure, relationships, and connection. No subject is dismissed as too awkward, complicated, or controversial to examine.
Uncensored Desire does not offer perfect formulas for love or intimacy. It creates honest conversations that challenge assumptions, invite self-reflection, and help us better understand ourselves and each other.
Because desire is never just about sex it reveals who we are.

title: Beyond The Quo
author: Stacey Luces
description:
If you’ve felt that restlessness—that feeling like there’s more than the midlife crisis or navigating a never-ending To do List - something beyond the status quo…. you’re in the right place.
Beyond The Quo isn’t about following the script; it’s about tearing it up. I’m Stacey Luces, and each week, I invite you to join me and our extraordinary guests - leaders, innovators, disruptors, and dreamers who’ve dared to challenge “the quo.”
 
This podcast is where we go past the expected, beyond the ‘shoulds’ and ‘musts,’– we break down old narratives about success, purpose, and authenticity.
 
In each episode we explore raw and honest stories filled with profound insights, strategies and practical advice that leads to bold transformation.
 
So, if you’re ready to claim your next chapter on your terms, If you’re done with the limits, the labels, and you’re ready to redefine success, and build a life that goes beyond the ordinary, hit that subscribe button and Join us each week for Beyond The Quo.
 
Subscribe on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, or wherever you listen to shows that inspire change…you’ve already done ‘the quo’—now let’s go beyond.”

title: Shit Is That Deep
author: Alicia Laszewski
description:
Welcome to Shit Is That Deep — because sometimes, it actually is. Hosted by Alicia Laszewski, this podcast tackles the stuff most people don't have a playbook for: toxic work environments, difficult group dynamics, and mobbing — a subtle, often-overlooked form of bullying that nearly everyone has either experienced or, without realizing it, participated in.

Too often, when we open up about these situations, we hear "it ain't that deep" or "can't you just get past it." Alicia and her guests are here to prove otherwise — and to actually help solve for it.

Each episode dives into the real dynamics behind toxic culture, group behavior, and interpersonal conflict at work, school, and on athletic teams, with a focus on kindness, honesty, and making people feel seen and heard. Expect real conversations — curious, sometimes unfiltered, always kind.

New episodes wherever you get your podcasts.

title: Free for the Fruit
author: Ashley David
description:
Free for the Fruit is a podcast about how to live in the fullness of the Fruits of the Holy Spirit. All Christians are given the gift of the Holy Spirit in their baptism and should expect to see the fruits of His presence in their lives, but many don't. Why is that?
Many Christians, without knowing it, will put up roadblocks to experiencing the Fruits of the Holy Spirit by edging God out, coming into agreement with lies, and relying on themselves. In this podcast we sort out those habits and beliefs we have developed that keep us from experiencing the presence of the Holy Spirit and instead craft lives that leave us Free for the Fruit.
Formerly known as the Authentic Uprising Podcast 
Produced by Pink Salt Riot - https://pinksaltriot.com

The podcast takes you through this wild moment in tech — one where AI is shaking up development, Apple’s Ternus era has begun and consumer technology is set to change more in the next five years than it has in the last 20. description:
Midnight Blocks takes you deep into the shadows of fictional urban streets, where loyalty comes with a price, ambition can turn deadly, and every decision has consequences. From ruthless hustlers and underground empires to broken friendships, dangerous rivalries, and unexpected redemption, each story explores the darker side of life in the city.
Every episode delivers a cinematic hood story filled with crime, betrayal, power, survival, and human drama. These are fictional tales inspired by the atmosphere of urban legends and crime dramas, created to entertain, immerse, and keep you wondering what happens next.
Turn down the lights, put on your headphones, and step into the Midnight Blocks. Here, every street has a story, every shadow hides a secret, and the night always remembers.

description: Faith Mobilized exists to bring biblical clarity to the most confusing, controversial, and consequential issues of our generation. Through conversations with trusted pastors, theologians, historians, and cultural leaders, we explore what the Bible actually says and equip believers to faithfully live it out. Our goal is to help Christians engage culture with truth, courage, and compassion, without compromising truth for compassion or abandoning compassion in the name of truth.

description:

Michael Bloomberg became a pioneer of the computer age, mayor of New York, one of the world’s most innovative leaders and generous philanthropists, and one of America’s most respected and fearless voices – and it all happened after he got fired at the age of 39. title: The Neuro Diaries Podcast
author: jaderosewrites
description:
Breaking stigma through stories.


The Neuro Diaries amplifies the voices of those experiencing Mental Health Conditions, Neurodivergence and Mental Illness. Interviewees articulate their lived experience with the condition from symptoms to diagnosis journeys and their experience of stigma. Breaking down what it ACTUALLY is, stereotypes aside.


Listen to real experience journeys of those with Autism, ADHD, Bipolar, C-PTSD, Peri & Post natal Depression, Anxiety, Major Depressive Disorder, OCD, Schizophrenia, Borderline Personality Disorder, Substance Abuse and more. Interviews with Psychologists and thought leaders offering fresh perspectives in this space.


I believe in the power of our stories—power in sharing them, feeling seen, and being heard.
Sometimes, the simple act of sharing your story and being witnessed in a community can bring healing, understanding, and cultural change.
This belief is the foundation of The Neuro Diaries; a safe space for people to share their stories, build connections, and create an authentic community.
Here, we come together to learn from each other, gain strength, and inspire cultural change.
My mission is to make the world a safer and happier place for neurodivergent children and those struggling with mental health conditions and mental illness.
Through sharing and connection, we can foster understanding, empathy, and support for all.

Housing Revolution, powered by BananaSplit Club and hosted by real estate operator and licensed general contractor Rahima Blaza, explores the people, ideas, and systems reshaping how housing works.

Through conversations with investors, operators, lenders, nonprofit leaders, housing professionals, and community partners, we get into the questions behind the headlines: How do you build housing models that work financially and operationally? What makes shared housing sustainable? How do financing, taxes, ownership, construction, and partnerships shape the outcome? And how can real estate create both economic value and meaningful human impact?

Expect candid conversations about real estate investing, shared housing, housing innovation, financing, tax strategy, property operations, nonprofit partnerships, community, and the realities of building and managing homes.

Because a housing model has to work on paper — and for the people who live there.

title: Visit Arundel Podcast
author: Mark Winship
description:
Welcome to the Visit Arundel Podcast, your backstage pass to one of the most characterful towns in West Sussex.


Part conversation, part local noticeboard and part nosy peek behind the scenes, the Visit Arundel Podcast celebrates the people, places, stories and experiences that make Arundel such a special place to visit, live and spend time.


Hosted by Mark and Caroline Winship, each episode gets under the skin of the town through relaxed conversations with the fascinating people who help make Arundel tick. Expect independent business owners, chefs and hospitality heroes, artists and makers, community characters, event organisers, local experts and plenty of familiar faces, along with a few people and stories you might not have discovered yet.


Mark and Caroline have been visiting and enjoying Arundel for more than 20 years through family, festivals, weekends away and countless return visits. They now call the area home and are the people behind Sefton Place, their boutique aparthotel and retreat venue just outside Arundel. The podcast gives them the perfect excuse to indulge their curiosity, meet more of the people behind the town and share what they discover along the way.


We will talk food and drink, things to do in Arundel, independent shops, history, art and culture, local events, the South Downs, countryside and walking, sport, hospitality, community life and the hidden corners of Arundel and West Sussex that deserve a little more attention.


There will be recommendations, behind the scenes stories, local knowledge, plenty of personality and a regular look at what is on in and around Arundel. Whether you are planning your first visit, returning for another weekend, or you are lucky enough to live locally, there should always be something new to discover.


New episodes every fortnight.


🎧 Come for Arundel. Stay for the stories.

Explore Arundel, discover what is on and plan your next visit at:

https://www.visitarundel.co.uk


The Visit Arundel Podcast is brought to you by Visit Arundel.

title: Tales From The Other Place
author: Tom Webber
description:
A series of standalone dramas from three fresh British writers. Each episode drops one impossible thing into an everyday life — a technology that probably shouldn't exist, a visitor who probably shouldn't be here, a door that definitely wasn't there yesterday — and listens closely to what it exposes about the human condition. The strange element is never the point; it's the pressure that forces a choice nobody is ready to make. Closer to The Twilight Zone than Black Mirror, this is speculative fiction about recognisable people behaving questionably under impossible circumstances.

In this podcast, Sarah — life coach, meaning counselor, author, and chronic wanderer — shares stories, reflections, and insights for anyone who wants to live more mindfully and authentically, without pretending life needs to be perfect first. Expect honest conversations about healing, growing, and finding meaning in the everyday chaos. This podcast feeds your inner life in the middle of busy, messy everyday life.

title: You Think This Is Real?
author: Camo Kimble
description:
You Think This Is Real?

The internet changed what success looks like.

The cars. The houses. The private jets. The followers. The exits. The perfect relationships. The overnight wins.

But how much of it is actually real?

You Think This Is Real? is a podcast hosted by Greg “Camo” Kimble that goes behind the image of success to uncover the stories people usually leave out.

Greg sits down with entrepreneurs, creators, leaders, and people who have lived behind the highlight reel to talk about what it actually took to get where they are—the money they lost, the things they rented, the businesses that nearly failed, the relationships put under pressure, the mistakes they buried, and the moments that never made it to social media.

Sometimes the image is fake.

Sometimes the success is real—but the story behind it looks nothing like the one you were sold.

And sometimes the most impressive thing about someone has nothing to do with what they own.

No highlight reel. No pedestal. No pretending.

Just honest conversations about success, failure, money, identity, and the increasingly blurry line between looking successful and actually living a successful life.

You’ve seen the image. Now hear the real story.

title: Polaris

description:
Polaris tells the true stories of polar exploration — the two centuries when the blank white spaces at the top and bottom of the map were the greatest adventure on Earth. Each episode, host Nirob takes one expedition — a squadron of British ships that vanished into the Arctic, a ship designed to be frozen and drift across the North Pole, a race to the South Pole won on skis and lost on foot, a rowboat crossing of the Southern Ocean after the ice crushed the ship — and rebuilds it: the map they were trying to finish, the men and the ships they bet on, the ice as it actually behaves, the moment it turned, and who came home.

From William Barentsz spending the first polar winter in a house built of driftwood, to Fridtjof Nansen drifting for three years in the Fram, to Ernest Shackleton, Douglas Mawson, Roald Amundsen and Robert Falcon Scott, Polaris is the history of human beings at the limit of what a body can endure. Meticulously researched, honest about the disputes that remain unsettled, and clear about the difference between the record and the legend. Clean and suitable for all ages. description:
What happens when the system you knew stops working, and there’s no rollback?


The Cutover: Stories of When the Switch Flipped is a podcast about the defining moments that change the direction of our lives, careers, and businesses.


Hosted by Lawrence Spector, an engineering leader with 25 years of experience building and leading teams across industries including finance, defense, telecom, medical devices, gaming, cybersecurity, and AI, The Cutover takes an engineering concept and applies it to something much more personal.


In technology, a cutover is the moment a new system goes live. Months of preparation lead to one point of no return. Life has cutovers too, but unlike at work, there’s usually no rehearsal, rollback plan, or war room waiting when they happen.


Each week, Lawrence shares a story from his own journey or sits down with founders, engineers, leaders, and builders to examine one real moment when something changed. The decision they almost didn’t make. The diagnosis they didn’t expect. The failure that forced a new direction. The opportunity that opened one door while closing another.


These aren’t highlight reels. They’re stories about what someone believed before, what actually happened, what became clear afterward, and what they would do differently now.


Because sometimes the most important part of the story isn’t where you ended up.


It’s the moment the switch flipped.

title: The Castaways of Disappointment Island (A True Survival Tale)
author: Herbert Escott Inman
description:
When the Dundonald sank in the treacherous waters off Disappointment Island in 1907, apprentice sailor Charles Eyre faced a harrowing fight for survival. Stranded on a desolate isle 500 kilometers south of New Zealand, Eyre and his fellow castaways endured seven grueling months of isolation, battling not just the elements but the haunting uncertainty of rescue. In "Castaways of Disappointment Island," Herbert Escott Inman masterfully recounts this true story of resilience against all odds.

Listeners will journey alongside Eyre as he navigates the challenges of limited food, harsh weather, and dwindling hope. The struggle for survival brings to light profound themes of camaraderie, despair, and the indomitable human spirit. Eyre's vivid memories paint a stark picture of life on the brink—where each day could be their last, yet also a testament to their will to live.

As the castaways forage for sustenance and craft makeshift shelters, they confront both physical and psychological trials that test their resolve. Will help ever arrive, or is their fate sealed on this unforgiving island? Discover the gripping tale of hope and perseverance in "Castaways of Disappointment Island," where every moment counts and survival is never guaranteed.
